Daily Devotional

May 6

18 The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints, (Ephesians 1:18 KJV)

The “eyes of your understanding” is talking about the eyes of our heart, or spiritual eyes. We have to have our understanding, or spiritual eyes, opened by the Lord to be able to perceive spiritual truths (Luke 24:25). The Holy Spirit gives the born again believer the understanding to be able to discern spiritual matters, but the world can not understand the things of God (Colossians 1:26).

Notice that this verse says, “the hope of his calling”, not our calling. Through our faith in Christ, we have become joint heirs with Christ of everything that He is entitled to (Galatians 3:29). What a deal, to be sons and heirs through Christ of all that is Gods. Wow!

Notice that this inheritance is in the saints, not out there in heaven somewhere. If we only knew what all this inheritance consisted of, that is already in us, we would be astounded (Romans 8:18), as it is the very Glory of God. Help us Lord, to understand what we already have been given through your grace.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
